title: Plant-based meat price and taste parity
bottleneck: Plant-based meat has plateaued: products cost more than conventional meat while matching it only approximately on taste and texture, and repeat purchase rates are low. The category promised parity on all three axes — price, taste, nutrition — and delivered on none fully; consumers tried it and drifted back. Incumbent meat keeps getting cheaper through scale the alternatives can't match.
why_it_blocks: Plant-based protein is the fastest route to cutting food-system emissions, but it only works if ordinary shoppers choose it over meat repeatedly — which they currently don't.
current_state: Sales have stagnated in key markets; the industry is consolidating around fewer, better products chasing cost reduction. Sales have stagnated in key markets; the industry is consolidating around fewer, better products chasing cost reduction.
